scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @evolve/frontend && node -e "fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'dist', { recursive: true })"
scripts.format: prettier --write frontend backend/scripts backend/tests backend/package.json backend/README.md docs package.json tsconfig.json vercel.json .prettierrc.json README.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check frontend backend/scripts backend/tests backend/package.json backend/README.md docs package.json tsconfig.json vercel.json .prettierrc.json README.md
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
